title Gimnasio Voltio - the electric gym: the gym's growing pulse, but it buzzes (an octave jump on every sixteenth), a tritone zaps against it, a chromatic climb and a snare roll; E minor
tempo 150
vol 235
meter 4/4
inst p1 v=120,80,60
inst p2 v=170,120,90
inst p3 v=220,160,120
inst p4 v=255,200,150
inst zap arp=-12,-6,0 rate=1 lvl=0.9
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
inst snr drum=a6 noise=25 seed=8 fall=12
l16
# --- the buzz alone, twice
@p1 o4 [ e >e< ]8 |
@p1 o4 [ e >e< ]8 |
# --- the beat comes in (kick on every beat)
@p2 o4 [ !kick:e >e< e >e< ]4 |
@p2 o4 [ !kick:e >e< e >e< ]4 |
# --- the tritone zaps (B flat against E)
@p3 o4 [ !kick:e >e< b- >e< ]4 |
@p3 o4 [ !kick:e >e< b- >e< ]3 @zap o5 e4 |
# --- the climb, chromatic, and a snare roll
@p4 o4 e f f+ g g+ a b- b >c c+ d d+ e f f+ g< |
[ !snr16 ]8 [ !snr16 ]8
